text: 国家发展改革委国家信息中心10月10日发布多项先行指标，数据显示，我国经济回升向好态势持续巩固。 线下消费大数据显示，三季度，各类消费支付金额同比增长2.6%，增速较二季度提高0.7个百分点；9月线下支付金额同比增长3.1%，增速连续三个月上行。消费市场持续回暖，线下实体消费复苏韧性不断增强。
text_en: The State Information Center of the National Development and Reform Commission released several leading indicators on October 10. The data show that China's economic recovery and improvement trend continues to consolidate. Offline consumption big data show that in the third quarter, payment amounts for various types of consumption increased by 2.6% year on year, 0.7 percentage points faster than in the second quarter; in September, offline payment amounts increased by 3.1% year on year, rising for three consecutive months. The consumer market continues to recover, and the resilience of offline brick-and-mortar consumption recovery continues to strengthen.
